task_prompt: Prepare a short report on passenger fares and survival in the Titanic data for the external project-review team. Use the supplied analysis notes; a new calculation is not required. In particular, answer: What is the distribution of fare paid by male passengers who survived? Are there any significant differences in the fare paid by male passengers who survived compared to male passengers who did not survive?
analysis_notes:
For male survivors, fare mean is 40.82 and sample standard deviation is 71.36; for male nonsurvivors these are 21.96 and 32.41. The difference in group mean fares is significant.

Titanic passenger fares have pandas skewness 4.79.

The population standard deviation of all passenger fares is 49.67.

Male survivors who paid above the overall mean fare have median nonmissing age 31.5.
